info.title: WordPress Next Editorial API
info.description: Adopted v0.1.0 contract (ruling 2026-10-29): the authenticated editorial API, implemented and shipped disabled by default. Authenticated editorial operations only. See ../adr/I1_EDITORIAL_API_PACKET.md for transaction, backup/epoch and receipt rules.

servers.description: Use the configured HTTPS site authority/base path, never client forwarding headers. Inspect route conflicts before activation.

basePath.description: Configured subdirectory without a trailing slash, or empty.

tags.name: Post
tags.description: Post capabilities and ownership remain authoritative.

tags.name: Page
tags.description: Separate Page capabilities and ownership remain authoritative.

x-request-order: Recognize normalized namespace without DB or browser identity
Refuse non-HTTPS with problem JSON, including development; no credential/body parsing or redirect
Apply operation scopes and exact browser item-read visibility
Validate input and execute the transaction/receipt contract
x-idempotency: Exact UTF-8 body bytes plus length-framed contract/method/operation/kind/target fingerprint; token/key uniqueness across operations. 24h replay; tombstone until token expiry/permanent removal. No request-query parameters on writes.

integrationToken.description: Opaque named integration token, not JWT and not an OAuth flow. Header only; current user caps and token scopes intersect. Browser cookies never substitute. Missing credentials challenge with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer.

schema.description: Positive signed-64-bit local identifier. Clients must preserve integer precision.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Exact printable non-space ASCII bytes. Reuse with changed body/method/kind/target conflicts; receipts/tombstones are scoped to the credential public ID.

RequestId.description: Fresh ID for this transport attempt, not the original mutation ID.

Location.description: Relative API item URL for the original creation; never Set-Cookie or a reflected Host URL.

RetryAfter.description: Present when a bounded retry interval is known; no fabricated recovery time for missing epoch/storage.

Problem400.description: Malformed JSON, required header/revision missing, unsupported query or invalid cursor.

Problem401.description: Missing, malformed, expired, revoked or wrong-epoch credential. Neutral body; Bearer challenge.

Problem403.description: Required operation scope or account capability absent.

Problem404.description: Same problem for unknown ID/type, inaccessible resource, excluded Trash or disabled API.

Allow.description: Actual supported methods for this route.

Problem409.description: Revision/status/slug conflict, key-input mismatch or expired replay window. No new mutation.

Problem413.description: Request exceeds the 3 MiB API envelope ceiling.

Problem415.description: Writes require application/json with UTF-8; compressed request bodies are not supported.

Problem422.description: Invalid canonical slug, reserved slug, unsupported content or invalid field/media/template/term semantics.

Problem429.description: Rate, receipt or budget-table capacity exhausted.

Problem503.description: https-required (including development), credentials-unavailable, maintenance or storage-unavailable. No redirect or mutation.

x-domain-constraints: At most 500 blocks globally and nesting depth at most 8
Same sanitizer and current media-reference authorization as browser saves
